# C01 — Subject / Defined Indefinability

## #0

**The Subject is that to which an appearance is present, without itself becoming one more appearance alongside it.** A thought, a remembered scene, an ache, an act of judgment and the thought “this is me” can each become something known. Their being known already involves the Subject. Adding that involvement to the description produces a further known relation; it does not put the one to whom the description appears inside it as another item.

This is intimate before it is theoretical. I can question a memory, revise my identity, fail to recognise myself in a portrait, or discover that an apparent certainty was mistaken. The questioning, failure and discovery are nevertheless present. What is at issue is not whether my description of myself is correct, but the presence within which correctness and error matter at all. Taylor's *Definition of God*, in its return to Zero, puts the pressure directly: “I am undeniable, though nowhere to be seen.” The word *I* here does not certify everything I say about myself. It names the first-person presence which an account of those sayings already enacts.

[[section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition|A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition]] **grounds** this distinction through the performed definition. C01 retains its reusable criterion: distinguish the presence to which something is given from the something given, including every representation of that presence. It does not repeat A01's complete movement through the predicates of God.

The finding can be stated in its fact/contents form. The fact of first-person immediacy is undeniable by definition: any denial of it is performed in the presence it denies. Its contents are not. A thought, a doubting, a self-image — and the thinking-thing a *res cogitans* names — remain determinate occurrences within that presence, corrigible like every determination. The classical reification converted the condition of appearing into one more appearance and then treated that conversion as capture of the condition; the essay's crossed zero names the resulting occlusion `Ø`. Denying the fact is impossible; reifying it is the opposite error; defined indefinability holds both edges at once.

## #1

**Defined indefinability** positively determines this asymmetry. It does not mean that the Subject is obscure because the correct description has not yet been found. It means that any description, however exact, remains a determination *for* the subject-pole it seeks to describe. The definition states why exhaustive objectification changes the office of its referent: it converts the condition of appearing into an appearance and then treats that conversion as capture of the condition.

A biography can identify a particular person. A physiological account can identify conditions of an experience. An introspective account can describe what that experience feels like. None becomes worthless because it does not exhaust the Subject. Each becomes more exact when it states what it determines and does not promote that determination into the whole reality of the one concerned. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C03-Determination|C03 — Determination]] **defines** the cut through which an account acquires this positive content; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C02-Faithful-Definition|C02 — Faithful Definition]] **extends** the requirement that the cut remain answerable to its referent.

The difference is between *I am* and *I am this*, not between a meaningful statement and silence. The second can be true: I am this person, speaking here, with this history and concern. It becomes false in office when *this* is made to exhaust the *am* through which the identification is lived. [[section-rooms/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference|A02 — Copula / Self-Identity through Difference]] **derives** the identification-through-difference that lets an identity be stated without cancelling the relation involved in stating it. C01 **qualifies** that operation at its first-person limit: an identifying predicate cannot substitute for the present act in which identification occurs.

## #2

Several things usually called “self” must therefore remain distinguishable. **Selfing** is an activity of appropriation: a changing determination is taken as mine, joined to the claim of what I am, and installed as the owner of the field. The **self-thing** is that determination treated as self-subsisting ground. A **bounded self**, by contrast, is a real situated horizon: this embodied life, with its history, limitations and capacity to be addressed. Its dependence does not make it unreal. **Subjectivity-as-such** names the unobjectifiable determining presence, while the capitalised **Self**, in this project's full symbolic use, names the whole relation of Subject and its objective internality, not the Subject isolated from manifestation.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C35-Selfing-Self-Subjectivity-Self-Thing|C35 — Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing]] **defines** these neighbouring offices in their own right. Their consequence here is exact: exposing a fabricated self-thing does not abolish the presence in which its fabrication is recognised. Conversely, affirming the Subject does not restore the self-thing as an invisible proprietor behind appearances. Neither the image nor an imagined owner of the image can occupy this place.

Taylor's protected encounter with Watson supplies the authorial pressure behind this distinction: the critique of selfing must reach its object without allowing the experient to disappear in the critique. [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness.md|Watson — The Resonance of Emptiness]] **sources** the Buddhist–psychotherapeutic comparison; Taylor's encounter and the Q27 selfing development articulate the further positive claim made here. This is **Argued from** that encounter, not an attribution to Watson of the native QL Subject or a claim that all Buddhist schools share one position. The copied leads in the protected notes remain authorial provenance; the source house separately records what has been checked against Watson's thesis and what still awaits book collation.

## #3

The Subject is not an inert witness placed behind a finished display. Knowing that I am does not first require an image of an unknown possessor and then a second observer who recognises it. It is present in the act of knowing. The reflexive relation is intrinsic to appearing; otherwise a luminous display would remain unexperienced, like a reflection that no one sees.

[[section-rooms/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa|A05 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa]] **extends** this inseparability of luminosity and reflective articulation. [[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]] **sources** its Śaiva comparison: the page-labelled discussion around p.70 distinguishes reflective awareness from an insentient mirror or crystal. C01 **compares** that operation with defined indefinability; it does not rename all Śaiva categories as synonyms for Subject. The source relation is **Paraphrased** for Dyczkowski's account and **Argued from** it for the project relation. The selected-edition quotation debt does not reduce the native claim to a conjecture.

The full QL field prevents this relation from freezing into an isolated pair. Its parent `/ = −/−` opens a determinate circumstance as `0/1`; `?/!` makes appearing answerable in question and assertion; `−/+` gives differentiation force; `X/x` distinguishes determining capacity from its local instance; `AM/IS` makes the relation personed and contextual; `∞/dx` retains exact local difference within inexhaustible depth; `1/0` returns the achieved determination toward its condition. The eight turns traverse the sixfold body; they are not eight interchangeable definitions of consciousness. `X/x` is Taylor's notation. Here its precise consequence is that no local `x`, including a self-image, exhausts the determining `X` it makes legible.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** this native sequence. C01 uses it to keep the Subject's relation alive through determination, context and return; the formal derivations retain their own homes.

## #4

First-person presence is always lived through a circumstance. Body, language, memory, feeling, attention, judgment and tools participate in that circumstance. They can be investigated because they are determinate; being internal to a person does not make them identical with the Subject. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality|C41 — Objective Internality]] **defines** this intermediate field. Its presence prevents the account from jumping directly between a disembodied knower and a world of finished external objects.

The second person makes the consequence unavoidable. I can know things about you and still have to hear your answer. Your presence is not another content I can produce by improving my image of you. In the project's own terms, inclusion within the whole does not give my situated self possession of your relation to that whole. [[section-rooms/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|A27 — Self and Other]] **tests** defined indefinability where an account meets someone who can answer and change its terms. The Watson–Gans–Levinas encounter **qualifies** any use of the Subject that would quietly install my viewpoint as the universal viewpoint.

This carries ontological force. The essay argues the order **Subject → objective internality → object**: a determinable world is available through the field of appearing, not through a private ego manufacturing everything it encounters. [[section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence|A34 — Idealism / Order of Dependence]] **extends** that position while distinguishing the directions and registers of dependence. Defined indefinability supplies its subject-pole; it does not collapse the ontological argument into the weaker observation that descriptions are incomplete.

An artificial system's memory, self-model, report or internal organisation can be richly determinate. No accumulation of those objects by itself establishes an unobjectifiable subject-pole. Equally, their objectifiability does not prove its absence. The exact phenomenal status and partition of a particular artificial process remain **Open**. This local empirical question neither settles nor suspends the essay's **Argued** order of dependence.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-eye-condition): The eye’s constitutive blindside **figures** defined indefinability through the difference between an image of the organ and the condition of its present seeing. Each further disclosure is real and still appears through a situated act. The subject-pole cannot be recovered as an extra object that would complete the inventory, while the gained knowledge remains available for faithful use.

Return does not mean adding a final portrait of the Subject to the collection. It means recognising the condition already involved in every portrait, judgment and attempt at recognition. The first-person force of *I am* remains, while its determinate descriptions become available for correction rather than being asked to stand as their own ground. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition|C19 — Recognition]] **defines** this recovery without acquisition. [[section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero|A36 — Advent of Integral Zero]] **extends** it into the achieved sign's return as Symbol: exact determination remains, now answerable to what it cannot own.

The [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field]] **grounds** C01's operational etymology relation. A name discloses; an account makes disclosure answerable; trust permits committed use without possession of the source. This is evidence register **3 — Operational homology**, not common lexical descent. C01 **returns-to** [[section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/02-s01-p1-define-subject|Movement02 — Define the Subject]] as the distinction the opening must hold, and **qualifies** [[section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/47-s50-p4-idealism-horizon|Movement47 — Idealism Horizon]] where that distinction bears the terminal dependency claim.

**Depth Restoration:** the defined-indefinability criterion, first-person pressure, selfing/self-thing/bounded-self/whole-Self discrimination, reflexive-luminosity comparison, second-person non-possession and strong dependency claim are restored here. A01 remains the performed proof; C35 owns the fuller self terminology; A05 and A34 own their developed comparative and ontological arguments. No canonical split or merge is required.

**Unresolved Delta:** Watson's selected1998 book and nested Gans quotations still require the collations named in its source house; Dyczkowski's selected-edition passage verification remains separately open. This page neither reproduces those unverified quotations nor inherits blanket claims about Buddhist, Śaiva or idealist traditions. Taylor's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md|Definition of God, Draft3]] **sources** the authorial first-person formulation; its theological comparisons retain their own evidence obligations. Artificial phenomenal localisation remains Open. These debts do not reopen the distinctions restored above.
